```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
}))

# Load scenario EVPPI cache (try label-aware name first, then legacy names)
cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", paste0("scenario_evppi_results_", utility_source_label, ".rds"))
if (!file.exists(cache_file)) cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", paste0("scenario_evppi_results_", utility_source_label, "_PREVIEW.rds"))
if (!file.exists(cache_file)) cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", "scenario_evppi_results.rds")
if (!file.exists(cache_file)) cache_file <- here("data", "tidy", "scenario_evppi_results_PREVIEW.rds")

if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  evppi_cache <- readRDS(cache_file)
  evppi_all <- evppi_cache$evppi_all_scenarios
  scenarios <- evppi_cache$scenarios
  data_available <- TRUE
  cat("Loaded EVPPI results:", nrow(evppi_all), "rows\n")
  cat("Models:", paste(unique(evppi_all$model_label), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Scenarios:", paste(unique(evppi_all$scenario_id), collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  warning("Scenario EVPPI cache not found. Please run script 14_scenario_EVPPIs.R first.")
  data_available <- FALSE
}
```

```{r build-grouped-table, include=FALSE}
if (data_available) {
  # Map parameters to publication-friendly groups
  param_group_map <- c(
    "c_drug_nivo" = "Drug costs",
    "c_drug_FLOX" = "Drug costs",
    "c_test_NGS" = "Test costs",
    "c_test_CT" = "Test costs",
    "c_test_blood" = "Test costs",
    "c_other_visit" = "Other costs",
    "c_other_baseline" = "Other costs",
    "c_other_follow" = "Other costs",
    "c_other_last" = "Other costs",
    "u_np" = "Utilities",
    "u_p" = "Utilities",
    "p_crp" = "Biomarker prevalence",
    "p_tlr" = "Biomarker prevalence",
    "p_tmb_braf" = "Biomarker prevalence"
  )

  # Assign interaction parameters
  interaction_params <- grep("^b_", evppi_all$parameter, value = TRUE)
  for (ip in interaction_params) {
    param_group_map[ip] <- "Treatment-biomarker interaction"
  }

  # Also handle [GROUP] entries
  group_params <- grep("^\\[GROUP\\]", evppi_all$parameter, value = TRUE)
  for (gp in group_params) {
    if (grepl("interaction", gp)) param_group_map[gp] <- "Treatment-biomarker interaction"
    else if (grepl("drug", gp)) param_group_map[gp] <- "Drug costs"
    else if (grepl("util", gp)) param_group_map[gp] <- "Utilities"
    else if (grepl("prevalence", gp)) param_group_map[gp] <- "Biomarker prevalence"
    else if (grepl("test", gp)) param_group_map[gp] <- "Test costs"
    else param_group_map[gp] <- "Other"
  }

  # Compute population-level EVPPI if not already in the data
  # Population scaling: annual incidence * discounted research horizon
  has_pop_col <- "evppi_population_millions" %in% names(evppi_all)
  if (!has_pop_col) {
    discounted_pop <- annual_incidence_norway *
      sum(1 / (1 + discount_rate_research)^(0:(research_horizon_years - 1)))
    evppi_all$evppi_population_millions <- evppi_all$evppi * discounted_pop / 1e6
  }

  # Filter to available scenarios
  target_scenarios <- c("base", "s1_decreased_nivo", "s2_wtp100k")
  available_scenarios <- intersect(target_scenarios, unique(evppi_all$scenario_id))

  scenario_labels <- c(
    "base" = "Base case (WTP 51k)",
    "s1_decreased_nivo" = "Biosimilar pricing",
    "s2_wtp100k" = "WTP 100k"
  )

  model_labels <- c(
    "joint" = "Model A",
    "focused" = "Model B",
    "separate" = "Model C"
  )

  evppi_grouped <- evppi_all %>%
    filter(scenario_id %in% available_scenarios) %>%
    mutate(
      param_group = ifelse(parameter %in% names(param_group_map),
                           param_group_map[parameter], "Other")
    ) %>%
    filter(param_group != "Other") %>%
    group_by(model_label, scenario_id, param_group) %>%
    summarise(
      evppi_per_patient = sum(evppi, na.rm = TRUE),
      evppi_pop_millions = sum(evppi_population_millions, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      scenario_display = scenario_labels[scenario_id],
      model_display = model_labels[model_label]
    )

  # Track which models are available for dynamic column names
  available_models <- sort(unique(evppi_grouped$model_display))

  cat("Grouped EVPPI results:", nrow(evppi_grouped), "rows\n")
  cat("Available models:", paste(available_models, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Available scenarios:", paste(available_scenarios, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r display-per-patient}
if (data_available && nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0) {
  # Per-patient EVPPI table (wide format: models as columns)
  per_patient_wide <- evppi_grouped %>%
    select(scenario_display, model_display, param_group, evppi_per_patient) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = model_display,
      values_from = evppi_per_patient,
      values_fill = 0
    )

  # Sort by first model column descending within scenario
  first_model_col <- available_models[1]
  per_patient_wide <- per_patient_wide %>%
    arrange(scenario_display, desc(.data[[first_model_col]]))

  col_names <- c("Scenario", "Parameter Group", available_models)
  col_align <- c("l", "l", rep("r", length(available_models)))

  kable(per_patient_wide,
        caption = "Per-patient EVPPI by parameter group, scenario, and model specification (EUR)",
        format = "html",
        col.names = col_names,
        digits = 2,
        align = col_align) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE,
                  font_size = 11) %>%
    pack_rows(index = table(per_patient_wide$scenario_display))
}
```

## Population-Level EVPPI

```{r display-population}
if (data_available && nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0) {
  # Population-level EVPPI table
  pop_wide <- evppi_grouped %>%
    select(scenario_display, model_display, param_group, evppi_pop_millions) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = model_display,
      values_from = evppi_pop_millions,
      values_fill = 0
    )

  first_model_col <- available_models[1]
  pop_wide <- pop_wide %>%
    arrange(scenario_display, desc(.data[[first_model_col]]))

  col_names <- c("Scenario", "Parameter Group", available_models)
  col_align <- c("l", "l", rep("r", length(available_models)))

  kable(pop_wide,
        caption = "Table S7: Population-level EVPPI by parameter group, scenario, and model specification (EUR millions)",
        format = "html",
        col.names = col_names,
        digits = 2,
        align = col_align) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE,
                  font_size = 11) %>%
    pack_rows(index = table(pop_wide$scenario_display)) %>%
    footnote(
      general = c(
        paste0("Population scaling: ", annual_incidence_norway, " patients/year over ",
               research_horizon_years, "-year research horizon, discounted at ",
               discount_rate_research * 100, "%."),
        paste0("Base case WTP: \u20AC", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), "/QALY."),
        "Biosimilar pricing: 80% discount from list price (nivolumab at approximately EUR 4,641/administration).",
        "Parameter groups aggregate individual parameter EVPPIs within each category.",
        "EVPPI = expected value of partial perfect information."
      ),
      general_title = "Notes: "
    )
} else {
  cat("EVPPI data not available. Please run scripts 12_PSA.R and 14_scenario_EVPPIs.R first.\n")
}
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
if (data_available && nrow(evppi_grouped) > 0) {
  tables_dir <- here("tables")
  if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
    dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  write.csv(evppi_grouped, file = here("tables", "table_s7.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Table saved to:", here("tables", "table_s7.csv"), "\n")
}
```
